transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I'd like to call this patent review meeting to order. As we all know, we have a patent application prepared for our battery-recycling process, with draft claims C1 through C5, ready for U.S. filing. The foreign filing route and final claim set still need legal approval, and the invention has not been publicly announced yet. I'd like to go through our standard patent-review routine today — I'll need to hear reports from patent, R&D, product, and international commercial counsel before I can give my final approval on the filing package. Let's start with the patent team's report. Who would like to go first?

The university listed in the collaboration records claims ownership of the subject matter of claim C1. This means the application can proceed with claim C1 only if we obtain written university consent or a license. I have not yet added this condition to the filing checklist, and I want to make sure we address this before Maya gives final approval on the filing package.
